basic_info.title: GAIA-1: A Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving

method.notes: ~9B-parameter world model for driving video; reports emergent scene understanding and LLM-like scaling behavior. Cited as domain-adjacent evidence that the world-model FAMILY scales when the training signal is rich (dense video prediction) — contrast with this project's pseudo-label matching objective near its entropy floor, where capacity alone cannot buy the same gains.

gap_analysis.whats_missing: Video generation for simulation, not GPS-to-segment matching; no road graph, no discrete segment actions.
gap_analysis.novelty_reasoning: Same class as Think2Drive/DreamerV3 — inspiration for P2 scaling, wrong task framing.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Adjacent automotive-industry world-model precedent (Wayve); shows where the driving industry is investing on the scaling axis.

uncertain: Cited from prior knowledge of the paper; not re-fetched during the 2026-07-11 review pass.
